# Syed Ahmed Haider

> Cloud & Systems Architect, Distributed Systems & Agentic AI Control Systems Engineer.

## Core Capabilities
- Agentic AI & Control Planes (Autonomous agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), persistent state machines, deterministic validation)
- Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture (AWS EKS, multi-region Kubernetes, Terraform, distributed systems)
- Systems & Desktop Engineering (Rust, Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, Node.js)

## Open Source Systems
- Foundry: Persistent orchestration and control-plane for long-running agentic coding pipelines.
  - Repository: https://github.com/syedahmedhaidershah/foundry
- MCP Local Ollama: Model Context Protocol bridge running Phi-4-mini locally via Ollama.
  - Repository: https://github.com/syedahmedhaidershah/mcp-local-ollama
- Screen Mind: Desktop application for eye strain (20-20-20 rule) and screen session telemetry built with Tauri v2, Rust, and React.
  - Repository: https://github.com/syedahmedhaidershah/screen-mind
